root_cause: Concurrent edits on the same SEO branch accumulated overlapping locale/revenue implementations. The merged lineage exposed contract mismatches in trailing-slash locale pairing, direct sitemap helper behavior, test syntax, quality-surface registration and preview/production pipeline parity.
prevention: After concurrent SEO writers converge, re-read the exact branch head before merge and collapse duplicate implementations rather than assuming earlier branch state.
Locale route pairing preserves canonical trailing-slash semantics.
Sitemap helpers and production generation share the same reciprocal hreflang contract.
New Netlify functions and database tables are registered in the quality-surface registry in the same lineage.
Deploy-preview and production build pipelines remain byte-for-byte equivalent for SEO stages.
fix: Repair locale pairing/tests, register new surfaces, keep preview and production SEO pipelines aligned, then prove current main through protected recovery delivery.
